note: zero hand-copy: both dumps are produced by the SQL below and hashed; the survey script reads only these files

queries.oss_inventory: select id,repo,tier,focus,status,lang,license,methods,multiphase,boundary,gpu,summary,cache_nodes,cache_commit from oss_inventory order by repo
queries.oss_solutions: select id,repo,feature_slug,tag,method,files,conventions,transfer,evidence from oss_solutions order by id

permissions_note: SELECT on oss_inventory/oss_solutions is not granted to the shell role; dumps were taken with runuser -u postgres (platform DB read-only role for the dump step)
